offering_description.value: Provides truckload, intermodal, dedicated contract and freight brokerage transportation services to shippers across North America. Moves customers' freight with its own tractors, trailers and containers, rail partners, and contracted or brokered carrier capacity.

primary_services.value: truckload transportation; intermodal rail-truck shipping; dedicated contract services; freight brokerage; last-mile delivery

customer_segment.value: B2B: shippers, retailers, manufacturers and logistics firms

end_markets.value: retail; manufacturing; consumer goods; automotive; food and beverage

revenue_model.value: service fees: freight transportation charged per load, mile or container; project or contract: multi-year dedicated fleet and logistics contracts with shippers

value_chain_position.value: service provider: moves and manages freight for shippers, sold to shipper and retailer customers; asset operator: owns and runs tractors, trailers and containers, sold as transport capacity to shippers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: truckload, intermodal, dedicated contract, brokerage and last-mile services sharing shipper customers and technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling transportation contracts to shippers; online: digital freight booking and tracking platform for shippers and carriers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: DOT and FMCSA safety and hours-of-service rules, plus emissions and environmental rules for trucks and rail
